title: In-class writing assessment with oral defense
summary: Software-engineering students complete a short in-class writing task, present it in no more than five minutes, and answer questions. The live presentation and question period let the instructor probe understanding when students may have used AI tools while preparing written work.

sources.title: Using Generative Artificial Intelligence Tools in Software Engineering Courses
sources.evidence_quote: In a different in-class writing assessment, students had to be creative when asked to present their writing assessment in five minutes or shorter. These assessments also had a question-answer session.
